verses.sanskrit:
व्यास उवाच।
              धृतराष्ट्र महाप्राज्ञ निबोध वचनं मम। वक्ष्यामि त्वां कौरवाणां सर्वेषां हितमुत्तमम्॥१॥
verses.english: Vyasa said: O greatly wise Dhritarashtra, hear my words. I shall tell you what will be the great good of all the Kurus.

verses.sanskrit: न मे प्रियं महाबाहो यद्गताः पाण्डवा वनम्। निकृत्या निकृताश्चैव दुर्योधनपुरोगमैः॥२॥
verses.english: O mighty-armed hero, it has not pleased me that the Pandavas have gone to the forest, having been dishonestly defeated by Duryodhana and others.

verses.sanskrit: ते स्मरन्तः परिक्लेशान्वर्षे पूर्णे त्रयोदशे। विमोक्ष्यन्ति विषं क्रुद्धाः कौरवेयेषु भारत॥३॥
verses.english: O descendant of Bharata, on the expiration of the thirteenth year, recollecting all their woes, they may shower virulent poisons on the Kurus.

verses.sanskrit: तदयं किं नु पापात्मा तव पुत्रः सुमन्दधीः। पाण्डवान्नित्यसङ्क्रुद्धो राज्यहेतोर्जिघांसति॥४॥
verses.english: Why does your wicked-minded and sinful son angrily want to kill the Pandavas for the sake of the kingdom?

verses.sanskrit: वार्यतां साध्वयं मूढः शमं गच्छतु ते सुतः। वनस्थांस्तानयं हन्तुमिच्छन्प्राणान्विमोक्ष्यति॥५॥
verses.english: Let the fool be checked; let your son remain quiet. In attempting to kill them (the Pandavas) now living in the forest, he will loose his own life.

verses.sanskrit: यथा हि विदुरः प्राज्ञो यथा भीष्मो यथा वयम्। यथा कृपश्च द्रोणश्च तथा साधुर्भवानपि॥६॥
verses.english: You are as pious as the wise Vidura, Bhishma, myself, Kripa or Drona.

verses.sanskrit: विग्रहो हि महाप्राज्ञ स्वजनेन विगर्हितः। अधर्म्यमयशस्यं च मा राजन्प्रतिपद्यताम्॥७॥
verses.english: O greatly intelligent man, dissension with relatives is improper. It is sinful and reprehensible. O king, you should desist from it.

verses.sanskrit: समीक्षा यादृशी ह्यस्य पाण्डवान्प्रति भारत। उपेक्ष्यमाणा सा राजन्महान्तमनयं स्पृशेत्॥८॥
verses.english: O descendant of Bharata, he (Duryodhana) looks towards the Pandavas with such jealousy that unless you interfere, great harm will be the consequence.
verses.bhavadeepa: स्वजनेन सार्धं विग्रहं मा प्रतिपद्यतां भवान् मागादित्यर्थः॥७॥

verses.sanskrit: अथवायं सुमन्दात्मा वनं गच्छतु ते सुतः। पाण्डवैः सहितो राजन्नेक एवासहायवान्॥९॥
verses.english: Or let this wicked son of yours go to the forest alone and unaccompanied. O king, O lord of men, if the Pandavas, from association with him, feel an attachment for your son, then good fortune will be yours.

verses.sanskrit: ततः संसर्गजः स्नेहः पुत्रस्य तव पाण्डवैः। यदि स्यात्कृतकार्योऽद्य भवेस्त्वं मनुजेश्वर॥१०॥
verses.bhavadeepa: अथवेति । भीमादिवद्वने सहवासात् तव पुत्रस्य युधिष्ठिरेण स्नेहश्चेत् त्वं कृतकृत्यो भविष्यसीत्यर्थः ॥९॥

verses.sanskrit: अथवा जायमानस्य यच्छीलमनुजायते। श्रूयते तन्महाराज नामृतस्यापसर्पति॥११॥
verses.english: O great king, it has been heard that a man's nature derived from his birth does not leave him till death. What do Bhishma, Drona and Vidura think? What do you think? What id proper should be done at once, else your purpose will ever remain unrealised.

verses.sanskrit: कथं वा मन्यते भीष्मो द्रोणोऽथ विदुरोऽपि वा। भवान्वात्र क्षमं कार्यं पुरा वोर्थोऽभिवर्धते॥१२॥
verses.bhavadeepa: एतदपि दुर्घटमित्याह अथवेति । न मृतस्यापि सर्पतीति पाठे सहजो दोषो जन्मान्तरेप्यनुवर्तत इत्यर्थः ॥११॥
